subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

The art of beautiful handwriting.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Calligraphy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Calligraphy"** refers to the art of beautiful handwriting. It involves the design and execution of lettering with a pen, ink brush, or other writing instruments. (सुलेख)
 
 
• **Example:** She practiced calligraphy for hours to perfect the elegant strokes of her letters.
 
 
• It is widely used for wedding invitations, font design, logo design, and decorative scripts.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Calligraphy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Typography** (मुद्रण कला): The art and technique of arranging type to make written language legible, readable, and visually appealing when displayed.
 
 
• **Example:** The designer used modern typography to create a visually stunning advertisement.
 
 

 
• **Etymology** (शब्द व्युत्पत्ति): The study of the origin and history of words and how their meanings have evolved over time.
 
 
• **Example:** The etymology of the word "robot" traces back to a Czech play.
 
 

 
• **Lithography** (पत्थर मुद्रण): A printing technique in which an image is drawn with a greasy substance onto a flat stone or metal surface.
 
 
• **Example:** The museum displayed ancient lithography prints from the 19th century.
